Sri. Goshika Venkatesham, vs The State Of Telangana on 10
September, 2024
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice C. V. Bhaskar Reddy

entities.text: Goshika Venkatesham, vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This Writ Petition is filed praying this Court to declare the action of respondent Nos.3 and 4 in interfering and trying to widen the road through the petitioner's land admeasuring Ac.0.20 guntas in Sy.No.786/AA; Ac.0.20 guntas in Sy.No.786/A and Ac.0.08 guntas in Sy.No.786/E/1/2, total admeasuring Ac.1.08 guntas situated at Rudraram Village, Patancheru Mandal, Sangareddy District,
without acquiring the same as illegal, arbitrary, in violation of the principles of natural justice and contrary to the procedure as contemplated under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency and Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short "the Act") and consequently direct respondent Nos.3 and 4 not to interfere with the peaceful possession of the petitioner over the subject property.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency and Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. The petitioner claims to be the owner and possessor of the land admeasuring Ac.0.20 guntas in Sy.No.786/AA; Ac.0.20 guntas in Sy.No.786/A and Ac.0.08 guntas in Sy.No.786/E/1/2, total admeasuring Ac.1.08 guntas situated CVBR, J Wp_25022_2024 at Rudraram Village, Patancheru Mandal, Sangareddy District, having purchased the same through different registered sale deeds bearing document Nos.3126 of 2000, dated 23.06.2000, 3128 of 2000, dated 23.06.2000, 2442 of 2001, dated 27.04.2001 and 11759 of 2006, dated 28.04.2006.

It is the case of the petitioner that since the date of purchase he is in possession and enjoyment of the subject property and the revenue authorities also mutated his name in the revenue records and issued pattadar pass book No.T09180010514 vide Khata No.1085.

The grievance of the petitioner is that for the purpose of expansion of National Highway No.65 (old NH No.9), the respondents have made forcible efforts to dispossess him from the patta land without following the procedure prescribed under the provisions of the Act.

3. Considered the submissions of the learned counsel for the parties and with their consent this writ petition is disposed of at the admission stage.
4.

Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing for respondent Nos.1 and 5 to 7, CVBR, J Wp_25022_2024 disputing the said submissions, has submitted that the respondents are proceeding with the work of widening of the National High Way No.65 in their own land and they are not interfering with the possession of the petitioner over the subject land.

5. In view of the above submissions and as the respondents are not interfering with the possession of the petitioner over the patta land admeasuring Ac.0.20 guntas in Sy.No.786/AA; Ac.0.20 guntas in Sy.No.786/A and Ac.0.08 guntas in Sy.No.786/E/1/2, total admeasuring Ac.1.08 guntas situated at Rudraram Village, Patancheru Mandal, Sangareddy District, this Court deems it appropriate to Sri. Goshika Venkatesham, vs The State Of Telangana on 10 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/7298946/
1 dispose of this writ petition directing the respondents not to interfere with the possession of the petitioner over the subject land and if the lands of the petitioner is required for the purpose of expansion of National Highway No.65 and the said lands were affecting in any manner, the respondents are further directed to follow the due procedure in accordance with the provisions of the Act.

sentences.text: With the above observations, this Writ Petition is disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
7. As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall stand closed.
